programs.title: The Wild Sides
programs.desc: The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the presence of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son.

programs.title: Savage Kingdom
programs.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savannah is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programs.title: Sea of Hope: America's Underwater Treasures

programs.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programs.desc: Meerkats teach young animals how to communicate.Viewers will also see a spider rolling on the dunes, a secretary taking care of the chicks and a gazelle.In the highlands, geladas elect leaders.
